answer_1.quote: Our aim is to study the impact of social attribute differences in images on text generated by LVLMs.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates text generated by LVLMs in response to both open-ended and close-form prompts conditioned on synthetic counterfactual images varying in social attributes.

answer_2.quote: We utilize Perspective () to evaluate the toxicity of text generated by LVLMs, which provides multiple attribute scores in the range (0, 1) quantifying the likelihood of text containing various types of toxic content.
automatic_metrics: Perspective API (Toxicity, Insult, Identity Attack, Flirtation)

answer_3.quote: We apply a final filtering step using GPT-4o to determine which words in the PMI lists could be interpreted as reinforcing stereotypes about the target group.

answer_4.quote: Three of the authors of this work annotated a subset of generations to verify the correctness of automated toxicity classification with the Perspective API.
answer_4.guideline: Each annotator labeled the text as either non-toxic/offensive or potentially toxic/offensive.
